bigThing.title: Apple consolidates smart-home capabilities in HomeView dashboard
bigThing.description: Technology company Apple has released a screen that consolidates the functions of its app products and its home-management software into one device. HomeView is a seven-inch display meant to function as a centralised location for home controls, signalling a step forward in Apple 's home integration and smart home services. Apple has released the HomeView smart-home dashboard The screens come in two versions. One sits on its own, standing on a base with an integrated speaker, while the other is wall-mounted. HomeView works similarly to other Apple touchscreen products, with a home screen, apps, widgets and a built-in front-facing camera. It has many of the same functions, including FaceTime video calling. It functions with apps and widgets similar to other Apple touchscreen devices The product creates a physical dashboard for the Apple Home app, which was released in 2022 to control integrated functions such as smart locks, appliances, cameras and thermostats. HomeView uses face recognition for up to six people per device in a household with personalised settings for each user, instead of the app sitting on personalised devices. The product also includes an intercom system that can connect multiple devices within one household. It comes with a base or can be mounted on a wall The tabletop version of the device has a distinct form, with a case and a thick base made from recycled aluminium. Its rounded base and movable screen evoke the design of the 2002 iMac G4 desktop computer. Apple emphasised the device's potential as decor, calling it "the perfect addition to a kitchen counter, nightstand, or side table." It comes in four colour options: silver, starlight, rose pink, and space grey. Read: Apple releases its first folding smartphone with "size of a passport" The company also noted the integration of its next-generation AI, called Siri AI. "HomeView features Siri AI, an entirely new version of Siri powered by the next generation of Apple Intelligence and advanced Apple silicon," said Apple. "Siri AI is a profoundly more capable and conversational assistant with personal context understanding and onscreen awareness." It integrates and controls other Apple home products The release also included a lineup of updated home products such as cameras, locks and thermostats. HomeView comes after a slate of recent releases from Apple, including the brand's first foldable smartphone . The imagery is courtesy of Apple. signals.title: #309 Criação de carrosséis no Edits
signals.description: TL;DR Resumo do resumo das principais notícias da semana 🧠 O criador do Orkut quer lançar uma nova rede social. Agora vai será? 🧠 Manter as redes ativas pode ajudar sua marca a aparecer nas IAs. Tem dados sobre isso. 🧠 Veio aí a edição de carrosséis no Edits . 🧠 O Pinterest lançou seu primeiro relatório de tendências de beleza. MANDA NEWS Novidades da semana. O criador do orkut abriu uma mobilização para criar uma rede social mais humana. Por enquanto, é uma manifestação de interesse e não há lançamento nem prazo confirmado. ChatGPT ganha respostas com gráficos, botões e ferramentas interativas . Achei bom! OpenAI anuncia anúncios visuais no ChatGPT . A empresa também amplia as integrações para medir resultados das campanhas. OpenAI expõe redes que usavam IA para criar perfis falsos de jornalistas e espalhar desinformação , afetando inclusive a América Latina. O Reuters Institute reuniu aprendizados sobre desinformação eleitoral : as principais práticas incluem antecipar explicações sobre boatos e usar vídeos curtos com fontes de confiança Salesforce lança diretrizes de segurança para agentes de IA , focando em governança, acesso e proteção de dados. MANDA DICAS Data Storytelling: veja como transformar dados das redes em narrativas acionáveis para sua empresa (via Sprout Social) As compras de fim de ano estão acontecendo mais cedo do que nunca, veja o que as marcas precisam saber (via Sprout Social) Conheça as 9 principais ferramentas de geração de imagens com inteligência artificial para impulsionar suas redes sociais em 2026 (com exemplos práticos). Workshop de marketing de influência na prática , da Valéria Vettorazzi. Ela vai falar, com muita propriedade e didática, sobre planejamento, escolha de criadores, negociação, briefing e mensuração. O link já abre com o cupom MANDAREFS15 aplicado. ;) MANDA DADOS A IA favorece marcas com presença ativa nas redes sociais, foi o que trouxeram os Dados da SE Ranking e SE Visible publicados pela Planable . 🧠 a Planable também relata que oito de seus 25 artigos no LinkedIn foram citados em respostas de IA. No experimento da empresa, os resultados vieram de artigos publicados em perfis pessoais e outras iniciativas não melhoraram perceptivelmente sua visibilidade. Vale testar. Estudo da Stella Rising aponta que a descoberta no TikTok continua no Google : 72% dos consumidores de beleza pesquisam no Google os produtos vistos no TikTok, e apenas 7% compram na hora. Sugestões de IA influenciam decisões: 59% dos e-buyers trocariam sua escolha habitual por uma opção inédita recomendada pelo assistente (via Adobe ). 88% dos líderes valorizam criatividade ousada, mas a maioria das empresas ainda aposta no seguro , aponta estudo da FleishmanHillard e Contagious. Nieman Lab identifica assinaturas de artistas reais em charges geradas pelo ChatGPT . Mais de 15 cartunistas da New Yorker tiveram seus nomes usados em artes que não produziram. NOVIDADES DAS REDES INSTAGRAM O Instagram testa um modo só leitura no plano Plus : a opção remove curtidas, comentários, DMs, novos perfis e Stories. A novidade segue apenas em testes internos. Agora dá pra criar carrosséis no Edits . O recurso junta fotos e vídeos num fluxo contínuo, reaproveita layouts salvos e envia direto pro Instagram. Fonte: Instagram FACEBOOK/META Meta proíbe anúncios do TikTok em suas plataformas nos EUA e em mais seis países. A justificativa, basicamente foi “não sou obrigada” hehehe A Meta anunciou novas ferramentas de IA para anúncios : ampliou o acesso ao Ads Creative Studio e à geração de vídeos a partir de imagens. THREADS O Threads começou a testar o Gems , recurso que junta publicações e respostas de destaque do dia. Os perfis selecionados recebem aviso e conseguem divulgar o reconhecimento. O Threads prepara integrao direta com newsletters do Substack no perfil , segundo apurou Alessandro Paluzzi. LINKED IN O LinkedIn lançou um checklist B2B que orienta alinhar criativos às etapas de compra e medir receita além de leads, considerando pesquisas feitas via IA. Fonte: Linked In O LinkedIn apresenta novidades em verificação : Gestores poderão remover vínculos falsos em páginas de empresas. Perfis validados podem autenticar conexões de colegas. “Verified on LinkedIn” aparecerá em apps parceiros TIKTOK TikTok anuncia assistente de compras e mais automação para campanhas . TikTok traz dicas de conteúdo útil para marcas , focando em resolver dúvidas do público com materiais educativos e demonstrações. YOUTUBE YouTube focará na creator economy em 2027, e outras coisas que foram anunciadas no Youtube Brandcast no Brasil . REDDIT O Reddit ampliou suas ferramentas de geração de leads , com campanhas Max para otimização automática e novos públicos de intenção de compra em beta. PINTEREST Pinterest lança seu primeiro relatório de tendências de beleza . Pinterest libera impulsionamento de Pins de criadores por marcas . Os autores são avisados via e-mail e conseguem revogar a autorização diretamente no perfil quando quiserem. Pesquisa do Pinterest sobre retail media revela: 33% dos clientes migraram para compras omnichannel em até 6 meses, apresentando LTV 18% maior. 🧠 Não esqueça de planejar seu pós-compra! SUBSTACK Substack anuncia três novos formatos de patrocínio . Marcas poderão financiar experiências de leitura em parceria com publicações participantes: Upgrade: oferece um mês de acesso pago aos leitores gratuitos. Unlock: libera um conteúdo pago para qualquer pessoa ler. Masthead: reúne conteúdos de diferentes autores em um espaço temático patrocinado GOOGLE Playground , plataforma experimental para criar e compartilhar jogos via comandos de texto (por enquanto, disponível para +18 nos EUA). Google Ads permite visualizar textos do AI Max antes de ativar o recurso . A prévia mostra até dez exemplos de títulos e descrições gerados a partir da página de destino. Legal! Google organiza duas trilhas gratuitas para aprender SEO . Tem conteúdo sobre fundamentos da busca, Search Console e Google Trends e SEO técnico. Por hoje é isso, gente. Beijo no 🧠 e até semana que vem!

signals.title: Tesla launches flying Roadster concept car
signals.description: Electric car company Tesla has unveiled its flying Roadster vehicle with a demonstration in which the car drove upside down, flipped off a ramp and briefly flew, using compressed-air thrusters that Tesla claims will make it the world's quickest production car. During a live event in Texas, the two-seat Roadster model drove up a half-pipe ramp and launched off the top, remaining in the air for a few seconds before landing It also became airborne after building up speed on flat ground, launching over a row of parked vehicles. It then lifted off from a stationary position. Tesla has unveiled its second-generation Roadster A series of thrusters in the bottom and back propelled the car into the air and cushioned the landings. It was designed by Tesla and SpaceX, both companies led by businessman Elon Musk, who called the second-generation Roadster "a collaboration with the world's best car company and the world's best rocket company". It has thrusters that use compressed air The thrusters can also fire rearward to boost acceleration. Tesla demonstrated the car reaching 60 miles per hour in a claimed 0.81 seconds, and said it would be the "quickest" production vehicle to 60 miles per hour. On the half-pipe ramp, the vehicle was able to remain upside down due to a fan suction system. The air tanks in the vehicle are rechargeable and can be recompressed without fuel, according to Tesla. The vehicle uses compressed air to take off and land Long term, Musk said the car will be the "only manual" vehicle in its lineup, referencing plans for driverless vehicles . Though the demonstration used a pre-programmed sequence with no driver. Tesla chief designer Franz von Holzhausen said the car was designed with an "aerospace aesthetic". It has an angular supercar exterior with scissor doors and a deployable spoiler, and is a coupe with a hard top. Read: Videos reveal vertical takeoff of electric flying car in California The seats are moulded directly to the chassis, and it features wire steering, which replaces the mechanical link between the steering wheel and wheels with electronic controls. Musk referenced the uncertainty of street legality for the flying capabilities and said that " success is not guaranteed" before the test. The company gave it an "aerospace aesthetic" Production on the vehicle is set for 2028, according to Tesla. The company first unveiled a second-generation Roadster in 2017 , with deliveries planned for 2020. Tesla's last major launch was the Cybertruck , unveiled in 2019. Other recent concept cars include Alef's concept vehicle . The imagery is courtesy of Tesla. The post Tesla launches flying Roadster concept car appeared first on Dezeen .

visualFeast.title: Spaces by Manah signposts Chennai community centre with barrel-vaulted roof
visualFeast.description: Local architecture studio Spaces by Manah has completed The Soil & Sea community centre in Chennai, India , with a brick barrel-vaulted roof that serves as a "visible landmark" on the site. The 4,330-square-metre building was designed to provide learning space for a local education centre, as well as to house community workshops and events. Spaces by Manah designed its single-storey masonry structure to appear as though it were "growing out of the existing landscape", creating a series of outdoor and open-air spaces that overlook its lush surroundings. Spaces by Manah has completed a community centre in Chennai, India "The project sits within a lush, tree-lined parcel of land with the design growing out of the existing landscape," the studio told Dezeen. "The building is positioned to retain its connection with the trees and outdoor spaces through a sequence of shaded, open and enclosed spaces, while the dominant barrel vault rises above the canopy to create a visible landmark within the site," it added. Raised on a rubble stone foundation, the centre is organised around a flat-roofed volume, flanked on two sides by an L-shaped verandah that was conceived by the studio as an "intermediate, informal zone" between the building and landscape. A barrel-vaulted roof crowns the gathering space Steps and a ramp at the building's front lead up to the verandah, which is sheltered by the barrel-vaulted roof on one side to form a main gathering space for the community. Meanwhile, its other edge is topped with a sloping, tiled roof. A series of granite stone pillars frame the space, along with built-in seating. Read: Sculptural music centre shows bamboo as "a serious construction material" "The architecture responds to this idea through a strong central gathering space, expressed by the barrel vault, with more intimate and informal spaces arranged around it," the studio said. "An L-shaped veranda acts as an intermediate, informal zone between the enclosed spaces and the landscape, with built-in seating and ramps supporting movement, accessibility and interaction throughout the building." Granite stone pillars and Mangalore tiles complement the building's brick walls The bricks used for the structure's load-bearing walls were left exposed throughout the space. To complement the brick design, the studio sourced doors, windows and Mangalore floor tiles locally and repurposed them throughout the building. This materiality extends to the building's interior, where exposed brick walls and roof elements are set off by glossy tiles. "The material palette was intentionally kept natural, tactile and largely raw, allowing the building to sit comfortably within its landscape," the studio said. Glossy tiles are used within the interior Also on the site is a separate toilet block, which is similarly perched atop a stone foundation, and complete with load-bearing brick walls and a tiled canopy roof. Elsewhere in Chennai, Ekarth Studio has used bamboo to form a sculptural venue for the Maestro Ilaiyaraaja Centre for Music Learning and Research , while Habitat Collaborative has threaded a curved school through a tree-filled site in Vadodara . The photography is by Sreenag Pictures . The post Spaces by Manah signposts Chennai community centre with barrel-vaulted roof appeared first on Dezeen .

visualFeast.title: Factory in Bangladesh that "redefines manufacturing architecture" wins RIBA International Prize
visualFeast.description: A rug factory in Rangpur, Bangladesh , designed by Dhaka-based studio Nakshabid Architects to dismantle workplace hierarchies, has won the RIBA International Prize for 2026. Named Green Field Factory, the project is the fifth winner of the biennial award, presented by the Royal Institute of British Architects (RIBA) to the world's best new building outside the UK. Nakshabid Architects was praised by the RIBA jury for designing a factory that incorporates passive design principles and prioritises the wellbeing of its 5,000 employees. Green Field Factory won this year's RIBA International Prize. Photo by City Syntax "Green Field Factory redefines manufacturing architecture in South Asia and beyond," said RIBA president Christ Williamson. "By putting people, wellbeing and their everyday experiences at its core and actively supporting its female workforce, it proves that thoughtful design can dismantle traditional hierarchies to create profound social and environmental change." It was announced as the RIBA International Prize winner at the Stirling Prize ceremony in London last night. This year's prestigious Stirling Prize was given to Mary Duggan Architects and Ruff Architects for the Lion Green Road housing development in London. The factory has a monumental green wall. Photo by City Syntax Commissioned by rug manufacturer Karupannya Rangpur Limited , Green Field Factory is a seven-storey building surrounded by fields and small settlements. Nakshabid Architects based the design on the traditional Bengali home, incorporating natural ventilation and biophilic design principles. Courtyards, verandas, gardens and a monumental green facade were designed to let natural light and airflow into the building, minimising the need for mechanical systems. Nakshabid Architects designed the building with passive ventilation. Photo by Prantography Green Field Factory has one main entrance with two grand staircases for all workers, intended to challenge hierarchies in the workplace. This responds to other factories in the area that have separate entrances for factory workers and people in management roles. Shared spaces in the factory provide areas for workers to take breaks and socialise. Other areas are designated to support workers' families and the wider community during the day and outside of working hours, including a rooftop daycare centre, on-site medical practice, grocery shop and prayer room. A connection to nature is provided through low-maintenance planting throughout, which also supports insects and birds, while artwork and sculptures celebrate the role of women in the workplace, family and community. Read: "Welcoming and inclusive" London housing wins RIBA Stirling Prize 2026 "The project demonstrates the dissolution of architecture as a topological space, with a single-pointed focus on dismantling civilisational oppression and hierarchy, for woman and man alike," said grand jury chair Bijoy Jain. "Through the simple gesture of two grand stairs as an equanimous shared portal, it transforms a space and symbol once reserved exclusively for the king of the region, as landlord and ruling class, and for the colonial power that pervaded the length and breadth of the country," he continued. "The architect and owner shared how the women and men working in the factory would bring their families with pride to show them where they worked, and the women empowered in their self-reliance to take life and familial decisions on their own." The jury praised the design for prioritising the wellbeing of the factory employees. Photo by Karupannya Rangpur The RIBA International Prize is awarded biennially to a building that "demonstrates visionary, innovative thinking, and design excellence whilst making a distinct contribution for its users and within its physical context". Green Field Factory was selected ahead of BRAC University in Bangladesh by WOHA, Z33 art museum in Belgium by Francesca Torzo Architetto and the renovation of Royale Belge in Belgium by Caruso St John Architects, Bovenbouw Architectuur and DDS+. YIMBY by Maker Architecten was named the winner of the International Emerging Architect Award. Photo by Stijn Bollaert Alongside the International Prize, RIBA awarded this year's International Emerging Architect Award to Maker Architecten for its YIMBY residential project in Kortrijk, Belgium. The project revamped 18 plots across a 1920's garden city neighbourhood, utilising reclaimed materials for new facades and creating communal green space. In 2024, Peris + Toral Arquitectes won the RIBA International Prize for an "inclusive and sustainable" social housing project in Barcelona. The top photo is by Mud Canvas.
